tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind the sidebar, dashboard and project pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tables, cards, the Gantt chart, inputs — the working surface.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table header row, collapsed group rows, hover rows, the weekend hatch in Gantt and heatmaps.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs and the task drawer (always with a shadow).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, card edges, dividers, Gantt gridlines. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and outline buttons (≥3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-muted in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-muted, surface-raised, primary-soft, sky-soft, internal-surface and heat-0…heat-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, column headers, timestamps, placeholders, breadcrumbs — on canvas, surface, surface-muted, surface-raised and internal-surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Logo navy. The one primary action per view (Simpan, Undang, Pindahkan), selected tab underline, active nav text, links; as text on the surfaces, primary-soft and sky-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active sidebar item, selected menu item background; primary or ink text on it.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Ariadne's red thread (the logo red) — the "you are here" colour: the logo thread, the Gantt today line, the active sidebar marker, the notification count. Never a button fill, a status, a focus ring or a warning. As text or a mark, on canvas, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: thread-soft
tokens.usage: Rare tint behind thread-coloured marks (the today label hover, the cover). Not for banners or mentions — those use sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Logo sky blue. Keyboard focus ring, context-banner icons and @mention text accents; ≥3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-muted in both themes.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Context banners ("Anda melihat sebagai Tamu", "Melihat dashboard: …") and @mention chips; ink or primary text on it.

tokens.name: internal-surface
tokens.usage: Background of internal comments (lock icon, hidden from guests); ink and ink-muted text on it.

tokens.name: internal-line
tokens.usage: Border of internal comments and of the Internal composer mode.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the mobile drawer.

tokens.name: status-not-started
tokens.usage: Not Started: outline colour of its pill and its (unfilled, dashed) Gantt bar; its icon.

tokens.name: status-not-started-ink
tokens.usage: Not Started pill label, on surface (the pill has no fill).

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: On Progress (logo blue): Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-progress-ink
tokens.usage: On Progress pill label and icon, on status-progress-soft.

tokens.name: status-progress-soft
tokens.usage: On Progress pill background.

tokens.name: status-fixing
tokens.usage: Fixing: Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-fixing-ink
tokens.usage: Fixing pill label and icon, on status-fixing-soft.

tokens.name: status-fixing-soft
tokens.usage: Fixing pill background.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked (the logo's deep crimson, darker than thread so the two never meet in lightness): Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-blocked-ink
tokens.usage: Blocked pill label and icon, on status-blocked-soft; also overdue dates (see danger).

tokens.name: status-blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Blocked pill background.

tokens.name: status-hold
tokens.usage: On Hold (dark grey): Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-hold-ink
tokens.usage: On Hold pill label and icon, on status-hold-soft.

tokens.name: status-hold-soft
tokens.usage: On Hold pill background (filled, unlike Not Started's outline).

tokens.name: status-request
tokens.usage: On Request: Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-request-ink
tokens.usage: On Request pill label and icon, on status-request-soft.

tokens.name: status-request-soft
tokens.usage: On Request pill background.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done (logo green): Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-done-ink
tokens.usage: Done pill label and icon, on status-done-soft.

tokens.name: status-done-soft
tokens.usage: Done pill background.

tokens.name: status-routine
tokens.usage: Rutin: Gantt bar fill, icon on its own.

tokens.name: status-routine-ink
tokens.usage: Rutin pill label and icon, on status-routine-soft.

tokens.name: status-routine-soft
tokens.usage: Rutin pill background.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: The status icon drawn inside a filled Gantt bar (every status fill except Not Started, which is unfilled); ≥3:1 on each fill in both themes.

tokens.name: priority-critical
tokens.usage: Critical priority icon (double chevron up) and its label, on the surfaces.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: High priority icon (single chevron up), on the surfaces.

tokens.name: priority-medium
tokens.usage: Medium priority icon (two bars), on the surfaces.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: Low priority icon (chevron down), on the surfaces.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Workload heatmap: 0 active tasks. Count text in ink. The scale runs from pale sky to logo navy.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Workload: 1 active task. Count text in ink.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Workload: 2 active tasks. Count text in ink.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Workload: 3 active tasks. Count text in ink.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Workload: 4 active tasks. Count text in on-heat.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Workload: 5 or more active tasks (overloaded). Count text in on-heat.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Count text on heat-4 and heat-5.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue finish dates and the Terlambat count — the red of Blocked text, so "late" and "blocked" read as the same alarm family.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; an alias of primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour; an alias of sky (≥3:1 on every surface in both themes).

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts (400, 500, 600). Dense tool: 14px body, 13px table cells. Use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for dates, durations and counts.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Login heading and empty states only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title: project name, Dashboard, Timeline Tim; the task title in the drawer.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and card headings, sub-project group rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Menunggu akses VPN dari klien sejak 22 Sep.
styles.usage: Default text: comments, descriptions, form fields, menus.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Task titles in lists and tables, names, button labels.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Table cells, Gantt labels, metadata rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Column headers, pill labels, badges, timestamps, heatmap counts.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number on dashboard summary cards only.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Task IDs in tables, drawers and notifications.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense data views use space-2/space-3; page gutters space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and chips; avatar overlap offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar; pill horizontal padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap between rows of a card list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and drawer section padding; sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1440px; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of page headers; login card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Login page vertical rhythm; empty-state spacing.

radius.note: Small and precise; round only for people and statuses.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, Gantt bars, heatmap cells, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers, the notification panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the login card, the mobile bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, count badges.

size.note: Fixed layout dimensions for the 1440px desktop and the 390px mobile view.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left sidebar (logo, Dashboard, Timeline Tim, project tree, Tim, Pengaturan).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with global search, bell and avatar.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows, Gantt rows, Today-list rows, menu items.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, filter chips.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Inline controls inside rows: status select, Tambah update, icon buttons.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Task detail drawer.

tokens.name: gantt-day
tokens.usage: Width of one day column at the Hari zoom (Minggu: 12px, Bulan: 4px).

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Gantt bar height inside a row-height row.

shadow.note: Elevation only for things that float. Flat surfaces use line hairlines, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Summary cards and the sticky table header.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, the status dropdown, @mention autocomplete, tooltips, the notification panel.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the task drawer.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px surface gap then 2px of solid sky. Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius.
